title: Data-visualisation palette (viz-1…4)
summary: Adds four categorical chart colours per theme as tokens (`viz-1`…`viz-4`), validated for colour-vision deficiency and ≥ 3:1 against surface in both themes. Charts can use `stroke-viz-1`, `bg-viz-2` and so on instead of local hex.
migration: Additive. New CSS variables `--viz-1…4` and Tailwind colours `viz-1…4`; tokens.json gains four colour tokens. Never use gold for data. Text stays in ink tokens.

compare.title: Trend chart
compare.note: Before: v2.0.0 has no chart palette — the proposal specimen defines local CSS variables. After: the series use the viz tokens (stroke-viz-1…) and switch with the theme.
